verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs say a plain-language description becomes a deployed full-stack app with a React + TypeScript frontend, and that describing a feature builds the endpoints, database tables and screens together. Projects are real TypeScript/React apps containing both pages/components and backend endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that one prompt reliably produces working frontend and backend together, and in-depth docs on the generation process.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app — React + TypeScript frontend,
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
